chain.label: Captain and first officer fatigue
chain.trigger: the captain was likely impaired by fatigue...the first officer's schedule and his reported difficulty adapting to frequently changing sleep cycles were conducive to the development of fatigue impairment

chain.label: First officer's severe congenital color vision deficiency
chain.trigger: the first officer suffered from a severe color vision deficiency that made it difficult for him to correctly identify the color of the PAPI signal

chain.label: Night visual approach over dark, unlit forest terrain (black hole conditions)
chain.trigger: the night visual approach to runway 9 at TLH was conducted over a protected national forest area that was devoid of ground lights or other visible references by which the pilots could judge their height above terrain

chain.label: Crew changed landing runway from 27 (with ILS) to 9 (visual/PAPI only), late in the approach
chain.trigger: about 0528:26, the first officer asked, "we ever decide if we're goin' nine or two seven?" The captain responded, "yeah, we can do nine if you want to."

caused_by.evidence: suggests that the captain's decision-making may have been degraded

chain.label: First officer flew a low, concave glidepath below the proper approach path to runway 9
chain.trigger: the first officer did fly a concave approach, with a steeper-than-normal initial descent, which is characteristic of a black hole approach

caused_by.evidence: black hole conditions, which likely contributed to the flight crew's failure to properly perform the approach
resulting in the performance of a nonprecision approach instead of a precision approach

chain.label: First officer failed to correctly perceive the sustained red PAPI lights as a low-glidepath indication
chain.trigger: he would definitely have had problems discriminating the PAPIs...because the red lights would appear not to be red at all, but...more indistinguishable from white

caused_by.evidence: the first officer suffered from a severe color vision deficiency that made it difficult for him to correctly identify the color of the PAPI signal
the PAPI lights would have shown a very low indication (four red lights), which would have been viewable from the cockpit for the remainder of the flight

chain.label: Captain declared the approach 'stable' and continued without a go-around despite excessive descent rate, low engine power, and low PAPI indication
chain.trigger: the captain stated, 'stable'...although the airplane's airspeed was within the target range, the airplane did not meet FedEx's criteria for a stabilized approach

caused_by.evidence: the accident approach was not stabilized as the airplane descended through 500 feet agl and that the pilots should have detected this and performed a go-around
this impairment contributed to his degraded performance...during the approach to TLH

chain.label: Captain and flight engineer failed to monitor the runway/PAPI environment and did not detect or challenge the continuous red PAPI display
chain.trigger: the captain and flight engineer failed to recognize the solid red PAPI display...and take action to correct the low approach

caused_by.evidence: impairment contributed to his degraded performance (especially in the areas of crew coordination and monitoring)
the flight engineer's failure to adequately monitor the approach...removed the last defense against the accident

chain.label: Airplane struck trees on short final and crashed short of runway 9
chain.trigger: the airplane collided with trees in a right-wing-low, slightly nose-up attitude during the approach to runway 9 then impacted the ground

caused_by.evidence: none of the flight crewmembers indicated that they ever saw all red lights on the PAPI during the approach
the flight engineer's failure to adequately monitor the approach...removed the last defense against the accident

chain.label: Three flight crewmembers seriously injured; airplane destroyed by impact and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the captain, first officer, and flight engineer were seriously injured, and the airplane was destroyed by impact and resulting fire

caused_by.evidence: the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postcrash fire
